messages.subject: ABB Thailand | Electrification, process industries and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear ABB Thailand Leadership Team,

ABB's work across electrification, process automation, mining, power and industrial efficiency closely mirrors the environment in which I have developed my executive value.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead senior engagement with government agencies, regulators, communities and strategic partners and coordinate complex requirements across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams.

My background gives me a customer-side understanding of what large industrial operators need from technology and infrastructure partners. I have supported external and governance work around a major solar and battery-storage transition, carbon-data readiness, operating approvals and stakeholder commitments in a remote mine setting. I understand both the strategic case for industrial decarbonization and the institutional work required to move projects forward.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN mandates in External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or senior industrial stakeholder roles. I have attached an ABB-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the appropriate Thailand leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
